Ṭaṅka
------------------------------------------
The Brahmasūtras is one of the three basic texts of Vedānta philosophy. In his scholarly commentary on the same—now known as the Śrībhāṣya—Rāmānuja (A.

-1137) refers to a few earlier commentators of his school of philosophy, one of whom is टङ्क. बोधायन is said to have written a Vṛtti (detailed commentary) on the Brahmasūtras, which was further elucidated by others like Guhadeva, टङ्क and Dramiḍa. Nothing more is known about any of them.
